_README: Hand-curated eval corpus. Each scenario has a prompt and two outputs: 'without' = what a model typically produces with NO useVyre context (realistic mistakes — invented props, raw hex colors, plausible-but-wrong variant names), 'with' = what the same model produces when given @usevyre/ai-context. Outputs live as files under fixtures/{with,without}-context/<id>.tsx. The scorer never trusts these labels — it re-measures every file with useVyre's own validator + a raw-color check.

scenarios.prompt: Build a primary call-to-action button that says 'Get Started'.
Render success, warning, and danger status badges.
Show an inline error alert telling the user their payment failed.
A medium-size search input with a leading search icon.
An elevated pricing card with a highlighted accent border.
